decisions.reason: The one-off absence of a recipient for the first mint changes no-referral commission and ticket issuance, but does not change the Small Block draw, prize, or eligibility rules for tickets that are actually issued.

The first-mint exception affects whether a no-referral ticket can be issued when no prior holder exists; it does not change VRF selection, randomness, weighting, or the eligible status of tickets that are issued.
